battery_chamber_cover_latch.name: Battery-chamber cover latch
battery_chamber_cover_latch.default_function: Slide the battery-chamber cover latch as shown and open the battery-chamber cover.

battery_latch.name: Battery latch
battery_latch.default_function: To remove the battery, press the battery latch to the side and slide the battery out of the camera.

bluetooth_button.name: Bluetooth button
bluetooth_button.default_function: The manual labels this button as Bluetooth-related but does not describe its operation.

dial_lock_release.name: Dial lock release
dial_lock_release.default_function: Releases the mode dial lock so the mode dial can be rotated.

diopter_adjustment_control.name: Diopter adjustment control
diopter_adjustment_control.default_function: Rotates to adjust viewfinder focus; lift before use and return to its original position to lock it.

disp_back_button.name: DISP (display)/BACK button
disp_back_button.default_function: Changes the display or returns to the previous screen.

drive_delete_button.name: DRIVE button / Delete button
drive_delete_button.default_function: Displays the drive-mode menu while shooting; deletes selected pictures in playback.

focus_stick.name: Focus stick (focus lever)
focus_stick.default_function: Tilts to select the focus area and navigate menus; pressing selects the focus area. Its role can be changed in FOCUS LEVER SETTING.

front_command_dial.name: Front command dial
front_command_dial.default_function: Rotates to control exposure settings, menu tabs or pages, quick-menu items, and picture browsing as described for the front command dial.

lcd_touchscreen.name: LCD monitor / Touch screen
lcd_touchscreen.default_function: When touch controls are enabled, supports touch photography, focus-area selection, function selection, movie optimized control, and playback.

lens_release_button.name: Lens release button
lens_release_button.default_function: Releases the lens for removal from the camera.

memory_card_slot_cover_latch.name: Memory card slot cover latch
memory_card_slot_cover_latch.default_function: Unlatch and open the memory card slot cover.

power_switch.name: ON/OFF switch
power_switch.default_function: Turns the camera on or off.

rear_command_dial.name: Rear command dial
rear_command_dial.default_function: Rotates to control exposure settings, menu items, quick-menu settings, and playback zoom as described for the rear command dial.

secondary_monitor_backlight_button.name: Secondary monitor backlight button
secondary_monitor_backlight_button.default_function: Turns the secondary monitor backlight on or off.

selector_down_button.name: Selector down button
selector_down_button.default_function: Highlights items below; Fn7 defaults to PERFORMANCE.

selector_left_button.name: Selector left button
selector_left_button.default_function: Highlights items to the left; Fn5 defaults to FILM SIMULATION.

selector_right_button.name: Selector right button
selector_right_button.default_function: Highlights items to the right; Fn6 defaults to SHUTTER TYPE.

selector_up_button.name: Selector up button
selector_up_button.default_function: Highlights items above; Fn4 defaults to PHOTOMETRY.

shutter_button.name: Shutter button
shutter_button.default_function: Half-presses for focus and, when enabled, exposure lock; full press releases the shutter.

ladders.basis: The firmware reads this ADC channel through 0x016c8898 (ADC block register 0xff906010+4*channel, masked 0xfff, cached by 0x017298ec at 0x02394b90+2*channel). Bands come from the factory configuration page (flash 0xc0000, XOR-DAT 0xc0274 decoded with 0xff); a body with its own valid configuration store reads its own bands. No released level is established: it is this channel's idle sample, a property of the body.
